title: A step that changes a role's duty changes its role text
why: The role texts went stale because a ruling or step that changes a role's duty never has to touch its role text. Owner's goal: accurate at the fastest speed (owner 13:13 CST Nov 10).
note: When a step that names a role (coordinator, triage, batch runner, lane) goes done, its PR also changes that role's text in skills/project-ops, or its body says 'no role text change'. A check reads it. Red first. Builds after role-texts-match-rulings. Added 09:36 CST Nov 13 (owner 09:35 CST: "is there anyway to reinstall them in place with the right briefs once ready? or again we'll need to do an archival wave into recreation?", relayed by the retrospective): when a PR that changes a role's text in skills/project-ops merges, the merge sends one git-mailbox message to each live session of that role: 'your role text changed at <commit>; re-read <path> on main'. No archive-and-restart wave. The session_start.sh tier line already reaches a live session at its next compaction or resume. Own mailbox, not upstream (ruling portable-own-features). The mail-on-merge part rides the one mail of step merge-mail-refreshes-sessions (retrospective 09:57 CST Nov 13).
